title: Velvet dunes
description: Deep aubergine cloth catches a narrow silver-blue grazing light.
useCase: Luxury fashion, music artwork, and material studies that need quiet depth.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. A height-field material study; no cloth simulation or external fabric texture.
look: Full-bleed deep aubergine cloth with slanted folds, narrow lilac-silver highlights along the ridges and fine thread lines.
motion: The folds undulate very slowly as sine terms in the cloth height drift with time, sliding the grazing sheen; the slider swings the light from left to right.
adapt: The cloth is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `cloth` is the fold heightfield (frequencies and `u_time` rates), `sheen` the specular exponent `34.0`, and `threads` the weave lines; recolour the base and sheen `vec3` values. Keep the WebGL lifecycle and reduced-motion branch.
